chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen's Bloody Crusade and Solitary Death Foretold - World of Immortality Chapter 336
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen leads celestial soldiers to slaughter half-ancestor disciples, breaks through to Nirvana Seventh Heaven, and leaves behind all loved ones to face his prophesied death alone.
og_title: A Bloody Reign Ends: Xiao Chen's Final Campaign in World of Immortality
og_description: In Chapter 336, Xiao Chen's unstoppable war against the half-ancestor disciples reaches its peak, but his premonition of death drives him to abandon his companions and walk toward his end.
